desc: sustain-loop Stage 1 (the productive pipeline) — runs the sustain-mine-smelt PLAN end to end: the orchestrator mines a 3-ore batch (mine count:3 self-completes), then chains into a full furnace cycle that smelts the dug raw iron into ingots. A small iron cluster sits beside the furnace bank so the bot is in reach of the furnace after mining (the base-return walk is the later autonomous phase). PASS = ORE_FOUND (mined) + SMELT_LOADED + SMELT_DONE (smelted), no ERROR. Furnace bank x=5 z=0..2 (plan targets the middle, 5,101,1); ore at x=3..4; bot at (4,101,1).
